record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, replace single-negative BPR with full-catalog cross-entropy at the existing masked target positions, averaging equally across those positions. Compute logits using the existing encoder states and tied item embeddings, excluding padding and the exclusive mask token from output classes. Catalog-wide competition may improve ranking discrimination relative to one sampled negative. Preserve masking and negative sampling, architecture, inference scores, optimizer, scheduler and batch/epoch settings; train one model per category.
